p.bio:
I started sailing at 8 years old. From which the ocean became my playground. I do most of the water sports you can think of, sailing, surfing, windsurfing, kiting, diving and fishing.
Throughout my sailing career, I’ve represented Seychelles in national and regional events in the ilca class, winning regional championships and being national champion twice. I have also done some European training events, mainly in Valencia. 
I have since moved on from ilca sailing and now skippering a keel boat in the fareast 28r fleet. 
Now currently sailing the ssl 47 boat, I’m excited to see what the future holds for my team in yacht sailing.

c: African & Oceanian Qualifiers - SSL Gold Cup 2026
